[Lesson w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-2 {"os":"windows","project":"docs"}) In PowerShell, normal display (and Get-Content output) can hide a BOM; before submitting a file whose first line must match exactly, verify the raw bytes (e.g. [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes) contain no BOM and that the first-line content is exact.

[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-2 {"language":"powershell","os":"windows"}) On Windows PowerShell, write multi-line files with Set-Content -LiteralPath <path> -Value @('line1','line2') so each array element becomes one line; Set-Content -Encoding utf8 writes a UTF-8 BOM, so a file's first line does not literally start with the intended text.
